content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect and program this [product_name] device using a USB adapter? Can I also use [product_name] programming software to do so?

You need to use [product_name] configuration software, at least version [version_no]. The article number refers to a [product_name] device of version [version_no]. Programming with [product_name] software is not supported for this device, regardless of the platform. For transferring programs and online monitoring, you only need an Ethernet cable. The USB adapter was previously used with older hardware versions if you didn't have a serial port.
Thanks! Can you explain what [article_no] refers to?
[product_name] devices started in the late 90s with series [article_no]. Later versions followed sequentially ([article_no], [article_no], etc.), with the current version identified as [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking about hardware compatibility and available programming methods for their automation device, including using USB adapters and certain programming software. It is clarified that only dedicated configuration software supports newer hardware, and Ethernet is now standard for programming and monitoring. There is also a need for clarification of different hardware series and versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward guidance on how to connect and program their device, preferably with commonly available options such as USB and familiar software platforms. Clear instructions regarding required cables, compatible software, and identification of hardware versions are desired.
